name: Digital Brutalism
tagline: Black, white, scanlines and a machine that types back.
description: Raw screen culture: pure black and paper white, CRT scanlines, dot-matrix display type set huge and cropped, ASCII fields, a barrel-warped image plane, coordinate read-outs, rolling counters that glitch between digits, typewriter captions with a block cursor and polarity-inversion cuts. Stepped, stuttering timing.

signature: polarity inversion: the whole frame flips white ↔ black on a cut, usually after a 3-frame glitch pair
resolution cascade: image → ordered dither → halftone dots → ASCII glyphs → dot-matrix letters
rolling counter with pixelated glitch frames between digits, landing on a held number
avoid: colour beyond black, white and one hot flash

camera: Screen-space: the image lives on a curved, barrel-warped plane with a slight perspective; moves are short stepped jumps or a slow drift of the plane, punctuated by smear frames.

texture.notes: CRT scanlines on everything (3 px pitch), ordered Bayer dither, pixelation and slice-offset glitch frames, horizontal smear frames, a hard vignette on the curved plane.

lighting: Emissive only: the screen is the light. Flash-photo highlights in hot red/orange burned into the dither; type is pure white on black or pure black on white.
sound: Machine room: keyboard clacks per typed word, CRT whine, short digital crunches on glitch frames, a sub thump on polarity cuts, counter ticks accelerating into a hold.

motionSummary: Moves like a machine thinking: a line types, the frame glitches and flips polarity, a counter rolls and slams to a hold, an image dithers into dots, glyphs and finally letters.

composition: two scales only: one huge cropped dot-matrix word or number, or one small typed mono line
machine chrome in the corners (coordinates, buffer counters, crosshairs), never in the middle
images live on a curved, barrel-warped screen plane with a hairline edge
visual.shapeLanguage: pixels, dots, scanlines, square cells, block cursors, dashed crosshairs; hard edges, no radii except the plane's barrel curve
visual.contrast: absolute: pure black vs paper white, whole-frame polarity flips; one hot flash ramp only inside dithered images

grammar.pacing: stutter: a calm typed line (1–1.5 s), a 2–3-frame glitch burst, a hard flip, a held number (1–2 s); repeat
grammar.rhythm: stepped and mechanical: states snap (steps:N), never tween; glitch frames in pairs; cuts in 3-frame groups
grammar.easing: stepped eases for enter/exit/morph; power-accelerating counters that slam into a hold; only the image plane drifts smoothly
grammar.acceleration: counters and scans accelerate to the stop (no settle); cuts are instantaneous; smear frames carry exits
movement: word-by-word typewriter with a block cursor
rolling digit reels landing on a held number
row-by-row scan-in of an image plane
resolution cascade: dither → halftone → ASCII → dot letters
slice-offset glitch pairs and polarity inversion
grammar.density: one thing at a time; the chrome ticks in the corners while the main element holds
grammar.holds: held numbers and typed lines hold dead still except for the blinking cursor and ticking read-outs

transitionPresets.name: Polarity flip
transitionPresets.build: a 2-frame slice/pixel glitch pair on the outgoing frame, then a hard cut where black and white swap; the next scene is already set in the new polarity
transitionPresets.sound: digital crunch, then a sub thump on the flip

transitionPresets.name: Resolution cascade
transitionPresets.build: an image on the curved plane dithers (Bayer), cells switch to halftone dots, then ASCII glyphs, then the cells inside a word mask become dot-matrix letters; each cell switches on its own stepped schedule so the change ripples
transitionPresets.sound: rising crunch texture per stage, a click on the last stage

transitionPresets.name: Scan-in
transitionPresets.build: the next layer appears row by row top-down (6–10 stepped rows), like a CRT painting the frame; the previous layer stays until overwritten

transitionPresets.name: Glitch pair cut
transitionPresets.build: two frames of slice-offset and pixelation on the outgoing shot, then a straight cut on the next beat; cuts come in 3-frame groups

transitionPresets.name: Cursor match
transitionPresets.build: the block cursor stays fixed while the frame changes around it, then becomes a pixel, a dot, or the first cell of the next word

transitionPresets.name: Smear exit
transitionPresets.build: 3–6 frames of horizontal smear (60–140 px streaks) carry the outgoing layer sideways; the next scene enters from the smear's direction or from black

archetypes.name: Typed line
archetypes.composition: one small lowercase mono line centred or flush left on black, block cursor, a dim ASCII field, coordinates in a corner
archetypes.elements: words typed one by one (4 f per word), blinking block cursor (8 f), ticking read-outs

archetypes.name: Counter slam
archetypes.composition: a huge cropped dot-matrix number on paper white, a dashed crosshair tracking a point, a typed caption under it
archetypes.elements: digit reels, glitch frames between digits, a '+' that appears on landing, a coordinate tag
archetypes.motion: reels roll with a power ease and slam into the held value; caption types after

archetypes.name: Curved image plane
archetypes.purpose: show the image (product, person, place) as screen material
archetypes.composition: a barrel-warped plane filling ~85 % of the frame, slight perspective, hairline edge
archetypes.elements: a flash photo rendered as ordered dither in the hot ramp; scanlines; vignette
archetypes.motion: scan-in row by row, then a slow tilt/drift of the plane (the only smooth move in the style)
archetypes.camera: the plane tilts 5–10° and eases flat

archetypes.name: Glyph word
archetypes.purpose: turn the image into the name
archetypes.composition: the plane's cells: a dot-matrix word built from the image's own cells, dim ASCII flickering around it
archetypes.elements: halftone dots, ASCII ramp, round dot letters
archetypes.motion: the resolution cascade ripples cell by cell; the word holds while the surrounding ASCII flickers

archetypes.name: Terminal sign-off
archetypes.composition: black frame, the name or URL typed small, the block cursor blinking alone
archetypes.elements: typed mono line, cursor, one read-out
archetypes.motion: type, hold, the cursor blinks 3 times; last frame = cursor alone

beats.purpose: the thing itself, as screen material

sequence.cutRhythm: stutter: calm typed lines between 2–3-frame glitch groups; polarity flips on downbeats; no crossfades, every change is a hard cut, a scan or a cascade

scenes.action: black; 'noise is a material.' types word by word behind a block cursor over a dim ASCII field; x/y read-outs tick
glitch pair, flip to white: 48210 rolls up on dot-matrix reels with glitch frames, slams, '+' appears; 'nodes online right now' types under it
flip to black; the curved plane scans in row by row, a dithered flash photo in red/orange, the plane tilts slowly
the photo's cells cascade to halftone dots, ASCII, then 'STATIC' in round dot letters made of the same cells; hold
smear frames sideways to black; 'static.dev' types; the cursor blinks alone

elements.text: typed word by word with a block cursor, or appears in one stepped snap; huge dot-matrix for numbers and names; never eases, never fades
elements.logo: built from the image's own cells (dot letters) or typed as a mono line; the cursor is its sign-off
elements.icons: pixel glyphs on a cell grid, or ASCII; they appear in one step
elements.images: only on the curved plane, dithered in the hot ramp; they scan in and cascade out to dots and glyphs
elements.ui: shown as raw screen: monospace read-outs, brackets, progress counters; no cards or shadows
elements.shapes: cells, dots, scanlines, crosshairs, brackets; hard square edges
elements.background: pure black or paper white, flipped as whole-frame polarity cuts; scanlines on everything
elements.particles: none as such; dither cells, ASCII glyphs and glitch slices are the only 'particles'

audio.sync: typed words on keyboard clacks; glitch pairs on off-beat hits; polarity flips on downbeats with a sub thump; counter ticks accelerate into the slam
audio.sfx: keyboard clacks, CRT whine, digital crunches, sub thumps, counter ticks, tape-stop crunch on smears
